description: This Java source file defines the SmsCampaignMapper class, which implements RowMapper for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to SmsCampaignData objects. It constructs SQL query strings for retrieving SMS campaign data and maps database results to domain objects.

classes.name: SmsCampaignMapper
classes.description: A Spring component implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to SmsCampaignData objects, including SQL query construction.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the schema string with the SQL select statement.
